traits.name: Sand Spin
traits.text: ⬻ Requirements The desert giant is standing in sandy terrain Effect The desert giant spins around and stirs up loose sand in a 10-foot emanation. Until the beginning of the giant's next turn, creatures in the area are concealed, and other creatures are concealed to them.

traits.name: Sandwalking
traits.text: Desert giants have adapted to the loose sands of the desert and can move across them with ease. Desert giants ignore non-magical difficult terrain and uneven ground caused by sand.

traits.name: Scimitar Blitz
traits.text: ⬺ The desert giant Strides up to their Speed, Striking once with each of their scimitars at any point during the movement.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ scimitar +21 (forceful, magical, reach 10 feet, sweep); Damage 2d6+12 (2d6+12) slashing

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ rock +19 (brutal, range increment 120 feet); Damage 2d8+12 (2d8+12) bludgeoning
